manaNeeded: {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
easyPrerequisites: Mardu Siegebreaker must be exiled by Werefox Bodyguard, and Glorious Protector must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Glorious Protector for its mana cost.
When Glorious Protector enters, it exiles Werefox Bodyguard until Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Glorious Protector's ETB.
When Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield, Mardu Siegebreaker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Mardu Siegebreaker enters, it exiles Glorious Protector until Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Mardu Siegebreaker's ETB.
When Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield, Werefox Bodyguard is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Werefox Bodyguard enters, it exiles Mardu Siegebreaker until Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Werefox Bodyguard's ETB.
When Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield, Glorious Protector is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
